why: scan_video samples at 6 FPS and downsizes frames before MediaPipe inference
activity score is matched hand-center displacement plus a one-time appearance signal
build_high_recall_runs requires hand_count > 0 and score >= threshold
a visible but static or slow hand can therefore have no proposal
proposal windows are motion anchors, not full hand-presence intervals or semantic actions

next_pass_policy.first_pass: hand-presence coverage for every source, retaining static and slow hands
next_pass_policy.second_pass: action boundaries from object/animal state change, reset, mirror direction and meaningful static context
